requirements.text: ▶ Open today's radar — nothing to install, no account
Reading, Atom subscriptions, follow controls, bookmarks and reading-library backup need no key or account.

Add a Tavily, Serper, Bocha, Jina or Firecrawl key, a self-hosted SearXNG, or any JSON search API (URL/body templates and dot-path result mapping), and results show inside the app and can feed summaries.
